def investigate(context, acquire):
    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        x = values[i]
        p = 2 * x * x * x - 2 * x * x
        w = (n - i + 2) * (n - i + 1) * (n - i) // 6
        total = total + w * p
    return total

def investigate(context, acquire):
    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    contrib = []
    for i in range(n):
        x = values[i]
        p = -2 * x + 0 * x * x + 0 * x * x * x
        g = 0
        if i > 0:
            g = 0 * x * values[i - 1]
        contrib.append(p + g)
    for pass_num in range(2):
        running = 0
        newlist = []
        for v in contrib:
            running = running + v
            newlist.append(running)
        contrib = newlist
    return contrib[-1]

def investigate(context, acquire):
    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    # Infer polynomial p(x) = a*x + b*x*x + c*x*x*x from single-element cases
    # p(1)=0, p(2)=6, p(-1)=0
    # a + b + c = 0
    # 2a + 4b + 8c = 6
    # -a + b - c = 0
    # From eq1 and eq3: a + b + c = 0 and -a + b - c = 0 => 2b = 0 => b = 0
    # Then a + c = 0 => c = -a
    # 2a + 8c = 6 => 2a - 8a = 6 => -6a = 6 => a = -1, c = 1
    # p(x) = -x + x*x*x
    def p(x):
        return -x + x * x * x
    # Build contribution list
    contrib = []
    for i in range(n):
        x = values[i]
        val = p(x)
        contrib.append(val)
    # Apply cumulative-sum passes until last entry matches expected
    # Try 1..4 passes, return last entry
    # We need to determine number of passes from examples.
    # Let's compute for each pass count and compare with known examples.
    # Known: [1] -> 0 (p(1)=0, any passes -> 0)
    # [2] -> 6 (p(2)=6, 1 pass -> 6, 2 passes -> 6, ...)
    # [1,1] -> -1: p(1)=0, p(1)=0 -> contrib [0,0] -> any pass -> 0, but expected -1
    # So there must be g*x times preceding value or sum.
    # Let's reconsider: contribution is p(x) plus g*x times either preceding value or sum of all preceding values.
    # For [1,1]: p(1)=0, p(1)=0. If g*x*prev: g*1*1 = g. If g*x*sum: g*1*1 = g.
    # Expected -1 after passes. If g=-1, contrib = [0, -1]. 1 pass -> [0, -1] last=-1. 2 passes -> [0, -1] last=-1. So g=-1 works.
    # For [2]: p(2)=6, no preceding, contrib=[6], last=6. OK.
    # For [1,2,1] expected 9. p(1)=0, p(2)=6, p(1)=0.
    # If g=-1 and prev: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=6 + (-1)*2*1 = 6-2=4, contrib[2]=0 + (-1)*1*2 = -2. contrib=[0,4,-2].
    # 1 pass: [0,4,2] last=2. 2 passes: [0,4,6] last=6. 3 passes: [0,4,10] last=10. Not 9.
    # If g=-1 and sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=6 + (-1)*2*1 = 4, contrib[2]=0 + (-1)*1*(1+2)= -3. contrib=[0,4,-3].
    # 1 pass: [0,4,1] last=1. 2 passes: [0,4,5] last=5. 3 passes: [0,4,9] last=9. Yes! 3 passes gives 9.
    # Check [1,1,1] expected -5. p(1)=0 all. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*1*1 = -1, contrib[2]=0 + (-1)*1*(1+1) = -2. contrib=[0,-1,-2].
    # 1 pass: [0,-1,-3] last=-3. 2 passes: [0,-1,-4] last=-4. 3 passes: [0,-1,-5] last=-5. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [2,1,0] expected 30. p(2)=6, p(1)=0, p(0)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=6, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*1*2 = -2, contrib[2]=0 + (-1)*0*(2+1)=0. contrib=[6,-2,0].
    # 1 pass: [6,4,4] last=4. 2 passes: [6,10,14] last=14. 3 passes: [6,16,30] last=30. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [1,0] expected 0. p(1)=0, p(0)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*0*1=0. contrib=[0,0]. 3 passes -> 0. OK.
    # Check [0,1] expected 0. p(0)=0, p(1)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*1*0=0. contrib=[0,0]. 3 passes -> 0. OK.
    # Check [1,0,0] expected 0. p(1)=0, p(0)=0, p(0)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0, contrib[2]=0. 3 passes -> 0. OK.
    # Check [-1] expected 0. p(-1)=0. OK.
    # Check [-2,-3] expected -48. p(-2)= -(-2)+(-8)=2-8=-6. p(-3)=3-27=-24. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=-6, contrib[1]=-24 + (-1)*(-3)*(-2) = -24 -6 = -30. contrib=[-6,-30].
    # 1 pass: [-6,-36] last=-36. 2 passes: [-6,-42] last=-42. 3 passes: [-6,-48] last=-48. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [3,0,0] expected 144. p(3)= -3+27=24. p(0)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=24, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*0*3=0, contrib[2]=0. contrib=[24,0,0].
    # 1 pass: [24,24,24] last=24. 2 passes: [24,48,72] last=72. 3 passes: [24,72,144] last=144. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [3,3,3,3] expected 345. p(3)=24. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=24, contrib[1]=24 + (-1)*3*3 = 24-9=15, contrib[2]=24 + (-1)*3*(3+3)=24-18=6, contrib[3]=24 + (-1)*3*(3+3+3)=24-27=-3. contrib=[24,15,6,-3].
    # 1 pass: [24,39,45,42] last=42. 2 passes: [24,63,108,150] last=150. 3 passes: [24,87,195,345] last=345. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [-3,3,-3,3,-3] expected -99. p(-3)=3-27=-24. p(3)=24. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=-24, contrib[1]=24 + (-1)*3*(-3)=24+9=33, contrib[2]=-24 + (-1)*(-3)*(-3+3)= -24+0=-24, contrib[3]=24 + (-1)*3*(-3+3-3)=24+9=33, contrib[4]=-24 + (-1)*(-3)*(-3+3-3+3)= -24+0=-24. contrib=[-24,33,-24,33,-24].
    # 1 pass: [-24,9,-15,18,-6] last=-6. 2 passes: [-24,-15,-30,-12,-18] last=-18. 3 passes: [-24,-39,-69,-81,-99] last=-99. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [-3,0,0,-2,0,0] expected -576. p(-3)=-24, p(0)=0, p(-2)=-6. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=-24, contrib[1]=0 + (-1)*0*(-3)=0, contrib[2]=0, contrib[3]=-6 + (-1)*(-2)*(-3+0+0)= -6 -6 = -12, contrib[4]=0 + (-1)*0*(-3+0+0-2)=0, contrib[5]=0. contrib=[-24,0,0,-12,0,0].
    # 1 pass: [-24,-24,-24,-36,-36,-36] last=-36. 2 passes: [-24,-48,-72,-108,-144,-180] last=-180. 3 passes: [-24,-72,-144,-252,-396,-576] last=-576. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [1,-3] expected -21. p(1)=0, p(-3)=-24. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=-24 + (-1)*(-3)*1 = -24+3=-21. contrib=[0,-21].
    # 1 pass: [0,-21] last=-21. 2 passes: [0,-21] last=-21. 3 passes: [0,-21] last=-21. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [0,3,2] expected 72. p(0)=0, p(3)=24, p(2)=6. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=24 + (-1)*3*0=24, contrib[2]=6 + (-1)*2*(0+3)=6-6=0. contrib=[0,24,0].
    # 1 pass: [0,24,24] last=24. 2 passes: [0,24,48] last=48. 3 passes: [0,24,72] last=72. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [0,0,-3,0] expected -72. p(0)=0, p(-3)=-24. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0, contrib[2]=-24 + (-1)*(-3)*(0+0)= -24, contrib[3]=0 + (-1)*0*(0+0-3)=0. contrib=[0,0,-24,0].
    # 1 pass: [0,0,-24,-24] last=-24. 2 passes: [0,0,-24,-48] last=-48. 3 passes: [0,0,-24,-72] last=-72. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [-2,-2,-2,-2,-2] expected -350. p(-2)=-6. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=-6, contrib[1]=-6 + (-1)*(-2)*(-2)= -6-4=-10, contrib[2]=-6 + (-1)*(-2)*(-2-2)= -6-8=-14, contrib[3]=-6 + (-1)*(-2)*(-2-2-2)= -6-12=-18, contrib[4]=-6 + (-1)*(-2)*(-2-2-2-2)= -6-16=-22. contrib=[-6,-10,-14,-18,-22].
    # 1 pass: [-6,-16,-30,-48,-70] last=-70. 2 passes: [-6,-22,-52,-100,-170] last=-170. 3 passes: [-6,-28,-80,-180,-350] last=-350. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [-4,4,-4,4,-4,4] expected -368. p(-4)=4-64=-60. p(4)= -4+64=60. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=-60, contrib[1]=60 + (-1)*4*(-4)=60+16=76, contrib[2]=-60 + (-1)*(-4)*(-4+4)= -60+0=-60, contrib[3]=60 + (-1)*4*(-4+4-4)=60+16=76, contrib[4]=-60 + (-1)*(-4)*(-4+4-4+4)= -60+0=-60, contrib[5]=60 + (-1)*4*(-4+4-4+4-4)=60+16=76. contrib=[-60,76,-60,76,-60,76].
    # 1 pass: [-60,16,-44,32,-28,48] last=48. 2 passes: [-60,-44,-88,-56,-84,-36] last=-36. 3 passes: [-60,-104,-192,-248,-332,-368] last=-368. Yes! 3 passes.
    # Check [-1,0] expected 0. p(-1)=0, p(0)=0. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0. 3 passes -> 0. OK.
    # Check [-1,0,2] expected 8. p(-1)=0, p(0)=0, p(2)=6. g=-1 sum: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=0, contrib[2]=6 + (-1)*2*(0+0)=6. contrib=[0,0,6].
    # 1 pass: [0,0,6] last=6. 2 passes: [0,0,6] last=6. 3 passes: [0,0,6] last=6. But expected 8. Hmm.
    # Wait, let's recompute: contrib[2] = p(2) + g*2*sum(prev) = 6 + (-1)*2*(0+0) = 6. 3 passes: [0,0,6] -> [0,0,6] -> [0,0,6] -> [0,0,6] last=6. Expected 8. So something is off.

    # For [1,2,1] expected 9: p(1)=0, p(2)=6, p(1)=0. g=-1 prev: contrib[0]=0, contrib[1]=6 + (-1)*2*1 = 4, contrib[2]=0 + (-1)*1*2 = -2. contrib=[0,4,-2].

def investigate(context, acquire):
    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    contrib = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        x = values[i]
        val = -x + x * x * x
        val = val - x * total
        contrib.append(val)
        total = total + x
    for _ in range(3):
        running = 0
        new_contrib = []
        for v in contrib:
            running = running + v
            new_contrib.append(running)
        contrib = new_contrib
    return contrib[-1]
